decisions.reason: The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits public referral statistics to replacement-contract referrals and excludes old-contract referral data.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits ticket accounting and dashboard visibility to replacement-contract NFTs and the new draw cycle.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already excludes old-contract NFTs from mint statistics and records the replacement contract's numbering restart.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already sources the public prize-pool statistic from the replacement contract's new draw state and excludes the old pool.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already restricts dashboard NFT ownership to successful replacement-contract mints and excludes old-contract NFTs.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already recalculates the countdown from the replacement contract's new draw cycle without old-contract progress.
Excluding the old contract from active systems necessarily changes the dashboard's commission and earnings accounting source to replacement-contract records.

value_updates.commission_accounting_source: Use only referral-commission and earnings records associated with replacement-contract NFTs and exclude records associated with old-contract NFTs.

decisions.reason: Starting fresh on the replacement contract does not alter the metadata attributes required for active NFTs; the source does not require modification of old NFTs' on-chain metadata.
The contract migration does not change the requirement to render NFT images and covers correctly for NFTs displayed by the active system.
The FAQ's current mint-number, referral, and prize explanations remain valid for replacement-contract NFTs, and the source does not require describing migration or legacy copies.
The candidate's message-539 INTRODUCE already fully records the fresh replacement state, numbering restart, exclusion of the old contract, and absence of legacy-copy migration.
The replacement-contract decision does not change the commission amount, trigger, recipient, timing, limit, or payout behavior.
